"""Typographer: sets the title, stamp and story lines in the skill's type and places them on the cuts.

Every line gets enough time to be read (0.75 s + 0.3 s a word), changes on a cut when one is near, stays in
the safe area, and is checked against what is behind it: on a bright background it gets a soft shade.
Rendered with libass (ASS subtitles) from the bundled fonts, so it is exact and fast.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import shutil

import numpy as np

from ...config import settings as app_settings
from .. import look
from ..model import AgentRun, Text
from ..render import still
from .base import Agent, Ctx, frame_size, load_analysis, out_fps


def _cased(text: str, case: str) -> str:
    return text.lower() if case == "lower" else text.upper() if case == "upper" else text


def _t(t: float) -> str:
    t = max(t, 0)
    return f"{int(t // 3600)}:{int(t % 3600 // 60):02d}:{t % 60:05.2f}"


def _bgr(hex6: str) -> str:
    h = hex6.strip("#").upper()
    return f"&H{h[4:6]}{h[2:4]}{h[0:2]}&"


def _clean(text: str) -> str:
    return text.replace("\\", "/").replace("{", "(").replace("}", ")").replace("\n", " ").strip()


def ass_document(W: int, H: int, texts: list[Text]) -> str:
    head = (f"[Script Info]\nScriptType: v4.00+\nPlayResX: {W}\nPlayResY: {H}\nWrapStyle: 0\n"
            "ScaledBorderAndShadow: yes\nYCbCr Matrix: TV.709\n\n[V4+ Styles]\n"
            "Format: Name, Fontname, Fontsize, PrimaryColour, SecondaryColour, OutlineColour, BackColour, Bold, Italic, "
            "Underline, StrikeOut, ScaleX, ScaleY, Spacing, Angle, BorderStyle, Outline, Shadow, Alignment, MarginL, "
            "MarginR, MarginV, Encoding\n"
            f"Style: Base,Montserrat SemiBold,48,&H00FFFFFF,&H00FFFFFF,&H00000000,&H00000000,0,0,0,0,100,100,0,0,1,0,0,5,"
            f"{int(W * 0.08)},{int(W * 0.08)},0,1\n\n[Events]\n"
            "Format: Layer, Start, End, Style, Name, MarginL, MarginR, MarginV, Effect, Text\n")
    ev = []
    for tx in texts:
        st = tx.style
        size, x, y = st["px"], st["x_px"], st["y_px"]
        an = {"left": 4, "right": 6}.get(st.get("align", "center"), 5)
        fi, fo = st.get("fade_in", 180), st.get("fade_out", 200)
        base = f"\\an{an}\\fn{st['font']}\\fs{size}\\fsp{st.get('spacing', 0)}\\bord0\\shad0\\fad({fi},{fo})"
        pop = "\\fscx116\\fscy116\\t(0,140,\\fscx100\\fscy100)" if tx.kind == "word" else ""
        txt = _clean(tx.text)
        a, b = _t(tx.start), _t(tx.end)
        if st.get("shade"):
            hh = int(size * 2.6)
            ev.append(f"Dialogue: 0,{a},{b},Base,,0,0,0,,{{\\an7\\pos(0,{y - hh // 2})\\p1\\1c&H000000&\\1a&H88&"
                      f"\\bord0\\shad0\\blur{int(size * 0.9)}\\fad({fi},{fo})}}m 0 0 l {W} 0 {W} {hh} 0 {hh}{{\\p0}}")
        sh = float(st.get("shadow", 0.5))
        if sh > 0:
            alpha = 255 - int(255 * min(sh, 1) * 0.6)
            off = max(1, int(size * 0.045))
            ev.append(f"Dialogue: 1,{a},{b},Base,,0,0,0,,{{{base}{pop}\\pos({x + off},{y + off})\\1c&H000000&"
                      f"\\1a&H{alpha:02X}&\\blur{max(2, int(size * 0.12))}}}{txt}")
        if st.get("glow"):
            ev.append(f"Dialogue: 1,{a},{b},Base,,0,0,0,,{{{base}\\pos({x},{y})\\1a&HFF&\\bord{max(2, int(size * 0.1))}"
                      f"\\3c{_bgr(st['color'])}\\3a&H90&\\blur{max(3, int(size * 0.2))}}}{txt}")
        ev.append(f"Dialogue: 2,{a},{b},Base,,0,0,0,,{{{base}{pop}\\pos({x},{y})\\1c{_bgr(st['color'])}}}{txt}")
    return head + "\n".join(ev) + "\n"


def install_fonts(ctx: Ctx) -> None:
    dst = ctx.root / "render" / "fonts"
    dst.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    for f in app_settings.fonts_dir.glob("*.ttf"):
        if not (dst / f.name).exists():
            shutil.copyfile(f, dst / f.name)


class Typographer(Agent):
    key, title, icon, color = "typographer", "Typographer", "type", "#c0caf5"
    role = "sets your title, stamp and story lines in the skill's type, on the cuts, and checks each can be read"
    needs = ("motion", "colorist")

    def inputs(self, ctx: Ctx):
        s = ctx.settings
        return [s.title, s.stamp, s.story, s.end_card, s.lowercase, s.aspect, s.resolution, ctx.skill.get("text"),
                [(g.kind, g.start, g.length, g.role, g.clip, g.src_in, g.speed, g.x0, g.fill) for g in ctx.project.timeline],
                ctx.project.look.get("luts"), ctx.hints.get("typographer")]

    def run(self, ctx: Ctx, rep: AgentRun) -> None:

        tl = p.timeline
        clips = [g for g in tl if g.kind == "clip"]
        texts: list[Text] = []
        if not clips:
            raise RuntimeError("nothing to put text on: the timeline is empty")
        c_start, c_end = clips[0].start, clips[-1].start + clips[-1].length
        cuts = [g.start for g in clips]

        def style(kind: str) -> dict:
            st = dict(T.get(kind) or T.get("story") or {})
            st["px"] = int(round(float(st.get("size", 0.05)) * short))
            st["x_px"] = int(round(float(st.get("x", 0.5)) * W))
            y = float(st.get("y" if portrait else "y_land", st.get("y", 0.6)))
            if portrait and kind not in ("title", "end"):
                y = min(max(y, 0.12), 0.84)  # platform safe area (top bar, caption and buttons at the bottom)
            st["y_px"] = int(round(y * H))
            st["y"] = y
            st.setdefault("color", "FFFFFF")
            return st

        if s.title:
            st = style("title")
            if st.get("card") and tl[0].kind == "card":
                st["y_px"], st["x_px"], st["fade_in"], st["fade_out"] = H // 2, W // 2, 400, 300
                texts.append(Text(kind="title", text=_cased(s.title, case), start=0.2, end=tl[0].length - 0.1, style=st))
                self.decide(ctx, rep, f"title card on black ({st['font']}), {tl[0].length:.1f}s")
            else:
                a = c_start + 0.2
                texts.append(Text(kind="title", text=_cased(s.title, case), start=a,
                                  end=min(a + float(st.get("dur", 2.4)), c_end - 0.2), style=st))
                self.decide(ctx, rep, f"title over the opening shot ({st['font']})")
        story_from = c_start + 0.25
        if s.stamp:
            st = style("stamp")
            dur = float(st.get("dur", 2.0))
            a = c_start + 0.2
            b = c_end - 0.3 if dur > 60 else min(a + dur, c_end - 0.3)
            texts.append(Text(kind="stamp", text=_cased(s.stamp, case), start=a, end=b, style=st))
            if dur <= 60:
                story_from = b + 0.15
            self.decide(ctx, rep, f"stamp '{_cased(s.stamp, case)}' {'for the whole film' if dur > 60 else f'for {b - a:.1f}s'}")
        lines = [ln.strip() for ln in s.story if ln.strip()]
        placed = 0
        if lines and T.get("words"):
            placed = self._kinetic(ctx, lines, texts, style("story"), case, story_from, c_end - 0.3)
        elif lines:
            st0 = style("story")
            reads = [min(max(0.75 + 0.3 * len(ln.split()), 1.3), 4.0) for ln in lines]
            avail = (c_end - 0.4) - story_from
            need = sum(reads) + 0.25 * (len(lines) - 1)
            scale = min(1.0, avail / need) if need > 0 else 1.0
            t = story_from
            for ln, r in zip(lines, reads):
                d = r * scale
                if d < 1.0 or t + 1.0 > c_end - 0.2:
                    break
                nxt = [c for c in cuts if t - 1e-3 <= c <= t + 0.45]
                if nxt and nxt[0] + d <= c_end - 0.2:
                    t = nxt[0] + 0.05
                texts.append(Text(kind="story", text=_cased(ln, case), start=round(t, 3), end=round(min(t + d, c_end - 0.2), 3),
                                  style=dict(st0)))
                placed += 1
                t += d + 0.25 * scale
            if scale < 1:
                self.decide(ctx, rep, f"{len(lines)} lines need {need:.1f}s, the edit has {avail:.1f}s: reading time "
                                      f"tightened to {scale:.0%}")
        if lines:
            ok = placed == len(lines)
            hint = {}
            if not ok and not s.length:
                hint = {"length_scale": round(min(2.0, (sum(min(max(0.75 + 0.3 * len(ln.split()), 1.3), 4.0) for ln in lines)
                                                       + 0.3 * len(lines)) / max(c_end - story_from, 1)), 2)}
            self.check(ctx, rep, "every story line placed", ok, f"{placed}/{len(lines)} lines on screen",
                       owner="cutter" if hint else None, hint=hint)
        if s.end_card:
            st = style("end")

                                  end=c_end - 0.1, style=style("end")))
        self._legibility(ctx, rep, texts, W, H)
        p.texts = texts
        install_fonts(ctx)
        ass = ctx.root / "render" / "text.ass"
        ass.write_text(ass_document(W, H, texts), encoding="utf-8")
        self.check(ctx, rep, "text inside the frame", all(0 <= t.style["y_px"] <= H for t in texts), f"{len(texts)} text events")

input.content:
"""Mixer: builds the soundtrack and hits the platform's loudness target.

Music enters on the downbeat the Cutter chose and fades out with the picture; the footage's own sound sits
under it at the skill's level (or carries the edit alone), with short fades at every cut so nothing clicks;
music ducks under speech when the skill asks for it; two-pass EBU R128 normalisation, then a measured check.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import re

from ... import media
from ..model import AgentRun
from .base import Agent, Ctx


def _atempo(speed: float) -> str:
    if abs(speed - 1) < 1e-3:
        return ""
    s, stages = speed, []
    while s < 0.5 or s > 2.0:
        stages.append(0.5 if s < 0.5 else 2.0)
        s /= stages[-1]
    return "," + ",".join(f"atempo={x}" for x in [*stages, round(s, 5)])


class Mixer(Agent):
    key, title, icon, color = "mixer", "Mixer", "wave", "#73daca"
    role = "builds the soundtrack: music from the chosen downbeat, the footage's sound under it, ducking, fades, loudness"
    needs = ("motion", "music")

    def inputs(self, ctx: Ctx):
        p, s = ctx.project, ctx.settings
        return [[(g.kind, g.clip, g.src_in, g.src_out, g.speed, g.start, g.length) for g in p.timeline],
                p.track.path if p.track else None, p.audio.music_in, ctx.skill.get("sound"), s.music_level, s.ambient,
                ctx.hints.get("mixer")]

    def run(self, ctx: Ctx, rep: AgentRun) -> None:
        p, s = ctx.project, ctx.settings
        snd = dict(ctx.skill.get("sound") or {})
        T = p.duration
        a = p.audio
        a.music = p.track.path if p.track else None
        a.music_db = float(snd.get("music_db", -3)) + float(s.music_level)
        a.ambient_db = float(s.ambient if s.ambient is not None else snd.get("ambient_db", -18))
        a.lufs = float(snd.get("lufs", -14))
        has_amb = any(p.clip(g.clip).has_audio for g in p.timeline if g.kind == "clip") and a.ambient_db > -50
        a.duck = bool(snd.get("duck")) and has_amb and any(p.clip(g.clip).sound for g in p.timeline if g.kind == "clip")
        last = p.timeline[-1]
        a.fade_out = round(min(3.0, max(1.2, last.length * 0.7 if last.kind == "card" else 2.0)), 2)
        work = ctx.root / "render"
        work.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        inputs, filters, amb = [], [], []
        n = 0
        if has_amb:
            for g in p.timeline:
                if g.kind != "clip" or not p.clip(g.clip).has_audio:
                    continue
                span = g.src_out - g.src_in
                inputs += ["-ss", f"{g.src_in:.4f}", "-t", f"{span:.4f}", "-i", p.clip(g.clip).master]
                L = g.length
                fi = max(0.02, g.fade_in)
                fo = max(0.02, g.fade_out)
                filters.append(f"[{n}:a]aresample=48000,aformat=channel_layouts=stereo{_atempo(g.speed)},"
                               f"volume={a.ambient_db:.1f}dB,afade=t=in:st=0:d={fi:.3f},"
                               f"afade=t=out:st={max(L - fo, 0):.3f}:d={fo:.3f},adelay={int(g.start * 1000)}:all=1[a{n}]")
                amb.append(f"[a{n}]")
                n += 1
        mus = None
        if a.music:
            path = ctx.abs(a.music)
            inputs += ["-ss", f"{a.music_in:.4f}", "-t", f"{T + 0.5:.3f}", "-i", str(path)]
            filters.append(f"[{n}:a]aresample=48000,aformat=channel_layouts=stereo,volume={a.music_db:.1f}dB,"
                           f"afade=t=in:st=0:d={a.fade_in:.3f},afade=t=out:st={max(T - a.fade_out, 0):.3f}:d={a.fade_out:.3f}[mus]")
            mus = "[mus]"
            n += 1
        if amb:
            filters.append(f"{''.join(amb)}amix=inputs={len(amb)}:normalize=0:duration=longest[amb]" if len(amb) > 1
                           else f"{amb[0]}anull[amb]")
        if mus and amb and a.duck:
            filters.append("[amb]asplit=2[amb1][sc]")
            filters.append("[mus][sc]sidechaincompress=threshold=0.03:ratio=6:attack=20:release=450[musd]")
            filters.append("[amb1][musd]amix=inputs=2:normalize=0:duration=longest[mix]")
        elif mus and amb:
            filters.append("[amb][mus]amix=inputs=2:normalize=0:duration=longest[mix]")
        elif mus:
            filters.append("[mus]anull[mix]")
        elif amb:
            filters.append("[amb]anull[mix]")
        raw = work / "mix_raw.wav"
        out = work / "audio.wav"
        if not filters:
            ctx.ffmpeg(["-y", "-f", "lavfi", "-i", "anullsrc=r=48000:cl=stereo", "-t", f"{T:.4f}", "-c:a", "pcm_s16le",
                        ctx.rel(out)])
            self.decide(ctx, rep, "no music and silent footage: a silent track")
            a.file = ctx.rel(out)
            rep.summary = "silent"
            return
        filters.append(f"[mix]apad,atrim=0:{T:.4f},alimiter=limit=0.95:level=disabled[out]")
        ctx.ffmpeg(["-y", *inputs, "-filter_complex", ";".join(filters), "-map", "[out]", "-c:a", "pcm_s16le",
                    "-ar", "48000", ctx.rel(raw)])
        meas = ctx.ffmpeg(["-i", ctx.rel(raw), "-af", f"loudnorm=I={a.lufs}:TP=-1.0:LRA=11:print_format=json",
                           "-f", "null", "-"]).stderr
        m = re.search(r"\{[^{}]*\"input_i\"[^{}]*\}", meas, re.S)
        if m:
            d = json.loads(m.group())
            af = (f"loudnorm=I={a.lufs}:TP=-1.0:LRA=11:measured_I={d['input_i']}:measured_TP={d['input_tp']}:"
                  f"measured_LRA={d['input_lra']}:measured_thresh={d['input_thresh']}:offset={d['target_offset']}:linear=true")
            ctx.ffmpeg(["-y", "-i", ctx.rel(raw), "-af", af, "-ar", "48000", "-c:a", "pcm_s16le", ctx.rel(out)])
        else:
            raw.replace(out)
        a.file = ctx.rel(out)
        parts = []
        if a.music:
            parts.append(f"music {p.track.name} from {a.music_in:.2f}s at {a.music_db:+.0f} dB, fading out over {a.fade_out:.1f}s")
        if amb:
            parts.append(f"footage sound at {a.ambient_db:+.0f} dB with 20 ms fades at every cut")
        if a.duck:
            parts.append("music ducks under speech")
        for t in parts:
            self.decide(ctx, rep, t)
        loud = media.loudness(out)
        if loud:
            ok = abs(loud["lufs"] - a.lufs) <= 1.0 and loud["true_peak"] <= -0.5
            self.check(ctx, rep, "loudness", ok, f"{loud['lufs']:.1f} LUFS (target {a.lufs:g}), true peak {loud['true_peak']:.1f} dBTP")
        rep.summary = (f"{p.track.name} · " if a.music else "") + f"{a.lufs:g} LUFS"

                                                        "credit": p.track.credit if p.track else None}, indent=1), encoding="utf-8")
        size = final.stat().st_size
        p.outputs = {"video": "final.mp4", "poster": "poster.jpg", "edl": "edit.edl", "json": "edit.json",
                     "bytes": size, "width": W, "height": H, "fps": fps, "duration": T,
                     "credit": p.track.credit if p.track else ""}
        self.decide(ctx, rep, f"final.mp4: {W}x{H} {fps:g} fps, {T:.1f}s, {size / 1e6:.1f} MB (H.264 + AAC, Rec.709)")
        self.decide(ctx, rep, f"{len(todo)} segment(s) rendered, {len(jobs) - len(todo)} reused · edit list for Premiere/Resolve: edit.edl")
        rep.preview = "poster.jpg"
        rep.summary = f"{W}x{H} · {T:.1f}s · {len(todo)}/{len(jobs)} rendered"

"""QA: measures the finished video and sends failures back to the agent responsible.

Every check is a measurement of the rendered file (or the edit that made it): duration, format, black and
frozen frames that weren't intended, loudness and true peak, pacing against the skill, cuts on the beat,
colour distance from the reference. A failure names its owner and a fix; the line re-runs from that agent.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np

from ... import media
from .. import analysis as an
from .. import look
from ..model import AgentRun
from .base import Agent, Ctx, frame_size, out_fps


class QA(Agent):
    key, title, icon, color = "qa", "QA", "shield", "#41a6b5"
    role = "measures the finished video and sends any failure back to the agent responsible"
    needs = ("export",)

    def inputs(self, ctx: Ctx):
        return [ctx.project.outputs.get("bytes"), ctx.project.outputs.get("duration")]

    def run(self, ctx: Ctx, rep: AgentRun) -> None:
        p, s = ctx.project, ctx.settings
        final = ctx.root / "final.mp4"
        info = media.probe(final)
        W, H = frame_size(s)
        fps = out_fps(p)
        T = p.duration
        self.check(ctx, rep, "render complete", abs(info["duration"] - T) <= 2.5 / fps + 0.05 and info["has_audio"],
                   f"{info['duration']:.2f}s vs {T:.2f}s planned, audio {'yes' if info['has_audio'] else 'missing'}",
                   owner="export")
        self.check(ctx, rep, "format", (info["width"], info["height"]) == (W, H), f"{info['width']}x{info['height']}",
                   owner="export")
        if s.length:
            self.check(ctx, rep, "length", abs(T - s.length) <= max(1.0, 0.06 * s.length),
                       f"{T:.1f}s for a {s.length:.0f}s target", owner="cutter",
                       hint={"length_scale": round(s.length / max(T, 0.1), 3)})
        # intended black: cards and fades
        planned = [(g.start, g.start + g.length) for g in p.timeline if g.kind == "card"]
        planned += [(g.start, g.start + g.fade_in + 0.15) for g in p.timeline if g.fade_in]
        planned += [(g.start + g.length - g.fade_out - 0.15, g.start + g.length) for g in p.timeline if g.fade_out]

        def intended(a: float, b: float) -> bool:
            return any(a >= x - 0.12 and b <= y + 0.12 for x, y in planned)

        blacks = [(a, b) for a, b in media.black_frames(final, 0.25) if not intended(a, b)]
        avoid = []
        for a, b in blacks:
            for g in p.timeline:
                if g.kind == "clip" and g.start < b and a < g.start + g.length:
                    sa = g.src_in + max(a - g.start, 0) * g.speed
                    avoid.append([g.clip, round(sa, 2), round(sa + (b - a) * g.speed, 2)])
        self.check(ctx, rep, "no unintended black", not blacks,

"""Export: renders every segment in parallel (unchanged segments are reused), assembles cuts and transitions,
burns in the type, lays the soundtrack under it, and writes the deliverables: the video, a poster, the edit
decision list (CMX 3600, opens in Premiere / Resolve) and the edit as JSON."""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
from pathlib import Path

from ... import media
from ..model import AgentRun
from ..render import render_segment
from .base import Agent, Ctx, fps_arg, frame_size, out_fps

XFADE = {"whip": "slideleft", "dissolve": "fade", "flash": "fadewhite"}


def _tc(t: float, fps: float) -> str:
    f = int(round(fps))
    n = int(round(t * fps))
    return f"{n // (3600 * f):02d}:{n // (60 * f) % 60:02d}:{n // f % 60:02d}:{n % f:02d}"


def edl(ctx: Ctx, fps: float) -> str:
    p = ctx.project
    lines = [f"TITLE: {p.name}", "FCM: NON-DROP FRAME", ""]
    n = 0
    for g in p.timeline:
        if g.kind != "clip":
            continue
        n += 1
        c = p.clip(g.clip)
        reel = c.id.upper()[:8]
        lines.append(f"{n:03d}  {reel:<8} V     C        {_tc(g.src_in, fps)} {_tc(g.src_out, fps)} "
                     f"{_tc(g.start, fps)} {_tc(g.start + g.length, fps)}")
        lines.append(f"* FROM CLIP NAME: {c.name}")
        if abs(g.speed - 1) > 1e-3:
            lines.append(f"M2   {reel:<8}      {g.speed * fps:05.1f}                {_tc(g.src_in, fps)}")
        if g.trans != "cut":
            lines.append(f"* TRANSITION: {g.trans} {g.trans_d:.2f}s")
        lines.append(f"* {g.role.upper()}: {g.why}")
        lines.append("")
    return "\n".join(lines)


class Export(Agent):
    key, title, icon, color = "export", "Export", "export", "#7dcfff"
    role = "renders every segment in parallel, assembles cuts and transitions, burns in the type, lays in the sound"
    needs = ("colorist", "typographer", "mixer")

    def inputs(self, ctx: Ctx):
        p = ctx.project
        return [p.timeline and [g.model_dump(exclude={"thumb", "why", "score"}) for g in p.timeline], p.look.get("luts"),
                p.look.get("fx"), p.look.get("grain"), ctx.skill.get("motion"), ctx.settings.aspect, ctx.settings.resolution,
                out_fps(p), (ctx.root / "render" / "text.ass").read_text(encoding="utf-8") if (ctx.root / "render" / "text.ass").exists() else "",
                p.audio.file, p.audio.model_dump()]

    def run(self, ctx: Ctx, rep: AgentRun) -> None:
        p, s = ctx.project, ctx.settings
        W, H = frame_size(s)
        fps = out_fps(p)
        fx, grain = dict(p.look.get("fx") or {}), p.look.get("grain")
        letterbox = fx.pop("letterbox", None)
        M = dict(ctx.skill.get("motion") or {})
        segdir = ctx.root / "render" / "segs"
        segdir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        tl = p.timeline
        jobs = []
        for i, g in enumerate(tl):
            lut = p.look.get("luts", {}).get(g.clip) if g.kind == "clip" else None
            whip_in = g.trans_d / 2 + 0.03 if g.trans == "whip" else 0.0
            nxt = tl[i + 1] if i + 1 < len(tl) else None
            whip_out = nxt.trans_d / 2 + 0.03 if nxt is not None and nxt.trans == "whip" else 0.0
            key = hashlib.sha1(json.dumps([g.model_dump(exclude={"thumb", "why", "score", "start", "id", "role"}),
                                           p.clip(g.clip).master if g.kind == "clip" else "", lut, fx, grain, W, H, fps,
                                           {k: M.get(k) for k in ("cadence", "weave")}, whip_in, whip_out, "v1"],
                                          sort_keys=True, default=str).encode()).hexdigest()[:14]
            jobs.append((g, lut, whip_in, whip_out, segdir / f"{key}.mp4"))
        todo = [j for j in jobs if not j[4].exists()]
        self.say(ctx, f"rendering {len(todo)} of {len(jobs)} segments ({len(jobs) - len(todo)} unchanged, reused)")

        def one(job):
            g, lut, wi, wo, out = job
            tmp = out.with_suffix(".tmp.mp4")
            render_segment(ctx, g, p.clip(g.clip) if g.kind == "clip" else None, W, H, fps, lut, fx, grain,
                           M, tmp, wi, wo)
            tmp.replace(out)
            return g.id

        with ThreadPoolExecutor(3) as ex:
            for sid in ex.map(one, todo):
                self.say(ctx, f"segment {sid} rendered", kind="progress", seg=sid)
        # assemble
        inputs, graph = [], []
        for i, (g, *_rest, out) in enumerate(jobs):
            inputs += ["-i", ctx.rel(out)]
            graph.append(f"[{i}:v]settb=AVTB,setpts=PTS-STARTPTS,fps={fps_arg(fps)},format=yuv420p[s{i}]")
        acc, acc_d = "s0", tl[0].length
        for i in range(1, len(tl)):
            g = tl[i]
            if g.trans != "cut" and g.trans_d > 0:
                graph.append(f"[{acc}][s{i}]xfade=transition={XFADE.get(g.trans, 'fade')}:duration={g.trans_d:.4f}:"
                             f"offset={max(acc_d - g.trans_d, 0):.4f}[x{i}]")
                acc_d += g.length - g.trans_d
            else:
                graph.append(f"[{acc}][s{i}]concat=n=2:v=1:a=0[x{i}]")
                acc_d += g.length
            acc = f"x{i}"
        post = []
        if letterbox and W > H:
            bar = max(0, int(round((H - W / float(letterbox)) / 2)))
            if bar:
                post.append(f"drawbox=x=0:y=0:w=iw:h={bar}:color=black:t=fill,drawbox=x=0:y=ih-{bar}:w=iw:h={bar}:color=black:t=fill")
        if p.texts and (ctx.root / "render" / "text.ass").exists():
            post.append("subtitles=render/text.ass:fontsdir=render/fonts")
        post.append("format=yuv420p")
        graph.append(f"[{acc}]{','.join(post)}[vout]")
        audio_i = len(jobs)
        inputs += ["-i", p.audio.file]
        final = ctx.root / "final.mp4"
        tmp = ctx.root / "final.tmp.mp4"
        T = p.duration
        ctx.ffmpeg(["-y", *inputs, "-filter_complex", ";".join(graph), "-map", "[vout]", "-map", f"{audio_i}:a",
                    "-c:v", "libx264", "-preset", "medium", "-crf", "18", "-profile:v", "high", "-pix_fmt", "yuv420p",
                    "-color_primaries", "bt709", "-color_trc", "bt709", "-colorspace", "bt709", "-r", fps_arg(fps),
                    "-c:a", "aac", "-b:a", "256k", "-ar", "48000", "-t", f"{T:.4f}", "-movflags", "+faststart",
                    ctx.rel(tmp)], timeout=3600)
        tmp.replace(final)
        # thumbnails for the timeline + poster
        thumbs = ctx.root / "render" / "thumbs"
        thumbs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        for f in thumbs.glob("t_*.jpg"):
            f.unlink()
        frames = [max(0, int(round((g.start + g.length / 2) * fps))) for g in tl]
        sel = "+".join(f"eq(n,{n})" for n in sorted(set(frames)))
        ctx.ffmpeg(["-y", "-i", "final.mp4", "-vf", f"select='{sel}',scale=-2:160", "-fps_mode", "passthrough",
                    "-q:v", "4", "render/thumbs/t_%03d.jpg"])
        order = sorted(set(frames))
        for g, n in zip(tl, frames):
            g.thumb = f"render/thumbs/t_{order.index(n) + 1:03d}.jpg"
        story = next((t for t in p.texts if t.kind in ("story", "stamp")), None)
        pt = (story.start + story.end) / 2 if story else next((g.start + g.length / 2 for g in tl if g.kind == "clip"), 0)
        media.frame(final, pt, ctx.root / "poster.jpg", height=720)
        (ctx.root / "edit.edl").write_text(edl(ctx, fps), encoding="utf-8")
        (ctx.root / "edit.json").write_text(json.dumps({"timeline": [g.model_dump() for g in tl],
                                                        "texts": [t.model_dump() for t in p.texts],
                                                        "audio": p.audio.model_dump(), "look": {k: v for k, v in p.look.items() if k != "graded"},
                                                        "credit": p.track.credit if p.track else None}, indent=1), encoding="utf-8")
        size = final.stat().st_size
        p.outputs = {"video": "final.mp4", "poster": "poster.jpg", "edl": "edit.edl", "json": "edit.json",
                     "bytes": size, "width": W, "height": H, "fps": fps, "duration": T,
                     "credit": p.track.credit if p.track else ""}
        self.decide(ctx, rep, f"final.mp4: {W}x{H} {fps:g} fps, {T:.1f}s, {size / 1e6:.1f} MB (H.264 + AAC, Rec.709)")
        self.decide(ctx, rep, f"{len(todo)} segment(s) rendered, {len(jobs) - len(todo)} reused · edit list for Premiere/Resolve: edit.edl")
        rep.preview = "poster.jpg"
        rep.summary = f"{W}x{H} · {T:.1f}s · {len(todo)}/{len(jobs)} rendered"

        rep.summary = "all checks pass" if not failed else f"{len(failed)} check(s) failed: " + ", ".join(c["name"] for c in failed)

"""Studio data: what the user asked for, what each agent measured and decided, and the edit itself."""

from __future__ import annotations

import time
from typing import Literal

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

# Output frame for each format (width:height). 2.39:1 is rendered as a letterboxed 16:9 frame.
ASPECTS: dict[str, tuple[int, int]] = {"9:16": (9, 16), "16:9": (16, 9), "1:1": (1, 1), "4:5": (4, 5), "2.39:1": (16, 9)}


class Settings(BaseModel):
    """Everything the user chooses. Agents read it; nothing else changes it."""
    skill: str = "bonzo"
    aspect: str = "9:16"
    resolution: int = 1080  # short side in pixels: 720 / 1080 / 2160
    fps: float | None = None  # None = follow the footage
    length: float | None = None  # target seconds; None = the cutter decides from the footage and the skill
    pacing: float = 1.0  # 0.6 (slower) .. 1.6 (faster)
    look: float = 1.0  # strength of the skill's colour look, 0 .. 1.5
    grain: float | None = None  # override the skill's film grain
    title: str = ""  # opening title (a card on black or an overlay, depending on the skill)
    stamp: str = ""  # time / place stamp, e.g. "7:28pm." or "lisbon"
    story: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)  # story lines, shown in order
    end_card: str = ""
    lowercase: bool | None = None  # None = the skill decides
    music: str | None = None  # None = skill default · "none" · "upload" · "library:<file>"
    music_level: float = 0.0  # dB relative to the skill's music level
    ambient: float | None = None  # dB for the footage's own sound; None = skill default
    beat_sync: bool = True
    transitions: bool = True
    slowmo: bool = True
    match_reference: bool = True
    reference_strength: float = 0.85


class Clip(BaseModel):
    id: str
    name: str
    path: str  # project-relative
    master: str = ""  # optimised edit master (project-relative); == path when the source is already light
    duration: float = 0.0
    width: int = 0
    height: int = 0
    fps: float = 30.0
    has_audio: bool = False
    analysis: str = ""  # npz with per-sample measurements
    analysis_fps: float = 0.0
    cuts: list[float] = Field(default_factory=list)
    shots: list[list[float]] = Field(default_factory=list)
    levels: dict = Field(default_factory=dict)
    flat: bool = False
    sound: list[list[float]] = Field(default_factory=list)  # regions with sound above the noise floor (speech, action)
    poster: str = ""
    filmstrip: str = ""
    best_t: float = 0.0  # the sharpest, best-exposed moment (used for previews)
    subject: float = 0.5  # where the subject usually is, 0 (left) .. 1 (right)


class Reference(BaseModel):
    name: str
    path: str
    duration: float = 0.0
    width: int = 0
    height: int = 0
    fps: float = 30.0
    poster: str = ""
    profile: dict = Field(default_factory=dict)


class Track(BaseModel):
    name: str
    path: str  # project-relative or absolute library path
    credit: str = ""
    duration: float = 0.0
    tempo: float = 0.0
    beats: list[float] = Field(default_factory=list)
    downbeats: list[float] = Field(default_factory=list)
    energy: list[float] = Field(default_factory=list)  # per beat, 0..1
    peaks: list[float] = Field(default_factory=list)  # waveform for the UI


class Seg(BaseModel):
    id: int
    kind: Literal["clip", "card"] = "clip"
    clip: str = ""
    src_in: float = 0.0
    src_out: float = 0.0
    card: float = 0.0  # duration of a card (black) segment
    speed: float = 1.0
    role: str = "hold"  # hook | hold | burst | jump | outro | card
    x0: float = 0.5  # reframe centre (fraction of source width) at the start / end of the segment
    x1: float = 0.5
    zoom0: float = 1.0
    zoom1: float = 1.0
    zoom_ease: Literal["linear", "punch"] = "linear"
    fill: Literal["crop", "blur", "fit"] = "crop"
    trans: str = "cut"  # transition into this segment: cut | whip | dissolve | flash
    trans_d: float = 0.0
    fade_in: float = 0.0
    fade_out: float = 0.0
    score: float = 0.0
    why: str = ""
    start: float = 0.0  # position on the timeline (computed)
    thumb: str = ""

    @property
    def length(self) -> float:
        if self.kind == "card":
            return round(self.card, 4)
        return round((self.src_out - self.src_in) / (self.speed or 1.0), 4)


class Text(BaseModel):
    kind: Literal["title", "stamp", "story", "end", "word"]
    text: str
    start: float
    end: float
    style: dict = Field(default_factory=dict)


class AudioPlan(BaseModel):
    music: str | None = None
    music_in: float = 0.0
    music_db: float = -3.0
    ambient_db: float = -18.0
    duck: bool = False
    fade_in: float = 0.05
    fade_out: float = 2.0
    lufs: float = -14.0
    file: str = ""


class AgentRun(BaseModel):
    key: str
    status: Literal["idle", "waiting", "working", "done", "cached", "skipped", "failed", "fixing"] = "idle"
    started: float | None = None
    ended: float | None = None
    summary: str = ""
    decisions: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    checks: list[dict] = Field(default_factory=list)
    before: str = ""
    preview: str = ""
    fingerprint: str = ""
    seconds: float = 0.0


class Project(BaseModel):
    id: str
    name: str = "untitled edit"
    created: float = Field(default_factory=time.time)
    state: Literal["empty", "preparing", "ready", "running", "done", "failed"] = "empty"
    settings: Settings = Field(default_factory=Settings)
    clips: list[Clip] = Field(default_factory=list)
    reference: Reference | None = None
    music_upload: Track | None = None
    track: Track | None = None
    skill: dict = Field(default_factory=dict)  # the resolved skill (built-in + reference + user overrides)
    look: dict = Field(default_factory=dict)  # colorist output: luts per clip, fx, primary per clip
    previews: dict[str, str] = Field(default_factory=dict)  # skill -> look preview still
    stages: dict[str, list[Seg]] = Field(default_factory=dict)  # each timeline agent's output, read by the next one
    timeline: list[Seg] = Field(default_factory=list)
    texts: list[Text] = Field(default_factory=list)
    audio: AudioPlan = Field(default_factory=AudioPlan)
    agents: dict[str, AgentRun] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    qa: list[dict] = Field(default_factory=list)
    loops: int = 0
    outputs: dict = Field(default_factory=dict)
    runs: list[dict] = Field(default_factory=list)
    trace_id: str | None = None
    error: str | None = None

    @property
    def duration(self) -> float:
        if not self.timeline:
            return 0.0
        last = self.timeline[-1]
        return round(last.start + last.length, 4)

    def clip(self, cid: str) -> Clip:
        return next(c for c in self.clips if c.id == cid)

lines: +    hints: dict[str, dict] = Field(default_factory=dict)  # fixes QA asked for; cleared when the user changes settings

from typing import Optional

import typer

from . import obs
from .config import settings
from .obs import console

app = typer.Typer(add_completion=False, no_args_is_help=True,
                  help="Cutroom: an AI post-production team. Raw clips + a brief -> an edited, captioned, checked video.")


def _start(command: str) -> None:
    obs.setup(tags=[f"cmd:{command}", f"prompts:{settings.prompts_version}"])


@app.command()
def make(
    brief: str = typer.Argument(..., help="What you want, e.g. '30s vertical teaser for Instagram, energetic, captions'"),
    footage: list[str] = typer.Argument(..., help="Clip files or globs"),
    style: Optional[str] = typer.Option(None, help="Force a style profile (see styles/)"),
    music: Optional[Path] = typer.Option(None, help="Music track to mix under the edit (ducked under speech)"),
    project: Optional[str] = typer.Option(None, help="Project id (default: timestamp + brief)"),
    open_sheet: bool = typer.Option(False, "--open", help="Open the edit sheet when done"),
):
    """Edit raw footage into a finished short video from a one-line brief."""
    from .pipeline import project_dir, run_project

    files = [f for pattern in footage for f in (glob.glob(pattern) or [pattern]) if Path(f).is_file()]
    if not files:
        raise typer.BadParameter("no footage files found")
    _start("make")
    st = run_project(brief, files, project, style, str(music) if music else None)
    _done(st, project_dir(st.project_id), open_sheet)


@app.command()
def resume(project: str = typer.Argument(..., help="Project id under projects/")):
    """Continue an interrupted project from its last saved phase / editor step."""
    from .pipeline import project_dir, run_project
    from .models import ProjectState

    path = project_dir(project) / "state.json"
    st = ProjectState.model_validate_json(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    _start("resume")
    st = run_project(st.brief, st.footage, project)
    _done(st, project_dir(project), False)


def _done(st, folder: Path, open_sheet: bool) -> None:
    if st.phase == "done":
        console.rule(f"[green]done[/green] · {folder}")
        for k, v in st.outputs.items():
            console.print(f"  {k}: {folder / v}")
        if open_sheet:
            webbrowser.open((folder / st.outputs.get("sheet", "index.html")).resolve().as_uri())
    else:
        console.print(f"[red]stopped at {st.phase}[/red]: {st.error}\nResume with: cutroom resume {st.project_id}")


style_app = typer.Typer(help="Style profiles: the measurable editing style the editor follows.")
app.add_typer(style_app, name="style")


@style_app.command("learn")
def style_learn(
    refs: Optional[list[str]] = typer.Argument(None, help="Local reference videos you have the right to analyse"),
    url: Optional[list[str]] = typer.Option(None, "--url", help="Public YouTube video to learn from (watched, never downloaded)"),
    name: str = typer.Option(..., "--name", help="Name for the new style profile"),
):
    """Learn an editing style from references and save it as styles/<name>.json."""
    _start("style-learn")
    if url:
        from .references import learn as learn_urls

        profile = learn_urls(list(url), name)
    else:
        from .style import learn

        files = [Path(f) for p in (refs or []) for f in (glob.glob(p) or [p]) if Path(f).is_file()]
        if not files:
            raise typer.BadParameter("give local reference videos or --url links")
        profile = learn(files, name, settings.cache_dir / "style" / name)
    console.print_json(data={k: v for k, v in profile.items() if k not in ("learned_from", "measured_from")})


@style_app.command("list")
def style_list():
    """Show the available style profiles."""
    import json

    for p in sorted(settings.styles_dir.glob("*.json")):
        s = json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        console.print(f"[bold]{p.stem}[/bold]: avg shot {s.get('avg_shot_seconds')}s · {s.get('description', '')[:110]}")


@app.command()
def doctor():
    """Check FFmpeg, the browser for graphics, and every model key."""
    import shutil

    from . import graphics, llm

    _start("doctor")
    for b in ("ffmpeg", "ffprobe"):
        console.print(f"{b}: {'[green]ok[/green]' if shutil.which(b) else '[red]missing[/red]'}")
    console.print(f"browser for graphics: {graphics.browser() or '[red]missing[/red]'}")
    console.print(f"GEMINI_API_KEY (vision): {'[green]set[/green]' if settings.gemini_api_key else '[red]missing[/red]'}")
    console.print(f"GROQ_API_KEY (speech-to-text): {'[green]set[/green]' if settings.groq_api_key else '[red]missing[/red]'}")
    for role in ("smart", "fast", "agent"):
        console.print(f"{role}: {', '.join(m for m in llm._chain(role))}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    app()

content.thinking: The subject stays around x=0.58–0.65, but plain saliency gets confused by the textured rocks and pulls the tracked centroid toward center (0.47). I'll rebuild the tracker to weight motion history, color distinctiveness, and skin tones, then lock onto the strongest peak instead of averaging across the frame.

def subject_track(fr: np.ndarray, chunk: int = 96) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Horizontal position of the main subject per frame (0..1) and a confidence.

    Combines spectral-residual saliency (Hou & Zhang 2007), motion that differs from the frame's typical
    motion (a moving subject rather than a moving camera) and skin tone, with a mild centre prior."""
    n = len(fr)
    xs_out, conf = np.zeros(n, np.float32), np.zeros(n, np.float32)
    prev = None
    for a in range(0, n, chunk):
        b = min(n, a + chunk)
        f = fr[a:b, ::2, ::2].astype(np.float32) / 255.0
        g = f @ LUMA
        F = np.fft.fft2(g)
        amp, ph = np.log(np.abs(F) + 1e-6), np.angle(F)
        sal = np.abs(np.fft.ifft2(np.exp((amp - blur2(amp, 1)) + 1j * ph))) ** 2
        sal = blur2(blur2(sal.astype(np.float32), 2), 2)
        sal /= sal.reshape(b - a, -1).max(1)[:, None, None] + 1e-9
        seq = g if prev is None else np.concatenate([prev[None], g])
        md = np.abs(np.diff(seq, axis=0)) if len(seq) > 1 else np.zeros((0, *g.shape[1:]), np.float32)
        if prev is None:
            md = np.concatenate([np.zeros((1, *g.shape[1:]), np.float32), md])
        md = np.clip(md - np.median(md.reshape(len(md), -1), 1)[:, None, None], 0, None)
        md = blur2(md, 2)
        md /= md.reshape(len(md), -1).max(1)[:, None, None] + 1e-6
        r, gg, bb = f[..., 0] * 255, f[..., 1] * 255, f[..., 2] * 255
        y = 0.299 * r + 0.587 * gg + 0.114 * bb
        cb = 128 - 0.168736 * r - 0.331264 * gg + 0.5 * bb
        cr = 128 + 0.5 * r - 0.418688 * gg - 0.081312 * bb
        skin = blur2(((cr > 136) & (cr < 173) & (cb > 77) & (cb < 125) & (y > 45)).astype(np.float32), 2)
        wmap = 0.5 * sal + 0.35 * md + 0.3 * skin
        xs = np.linspace(0, 1, g.shape[2], dtype=np.float32)
        wmap *= (0.55 + 0.45 * np.exp(-((xs - 0.5) ** 2) / (2 * 0.28 ** 2)))[None, None, :]
        col = wmap.sum(1) ** 2
        xs_out[a:b] = (col * xs).sum(1) / (col.sum(1) + 1e-9)
        conf[a:b] = col.max(1) / (col.mean(1) + 1e-9)
        prev = g[-1]
    return xs_out, conf

def _pnorm(m: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Normalise each frame of a map stack by its 99th percentile."""
    hi = np.percentile(m.reshape(len(m), -1), 99, axis=1)[:, None, None]
    return np.clip(m / (hi + 1e-6), 0, 1)


def subject_track(fr: np.ndarray, fps: float = 8.0) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Horizontal position of the main subject per frame (0..1) and a confidence. No model:

    - activity: where the picture changes over ~1.5 s, minus the frame's typical change (so a moving subject
      counts and a moving camera doesn't);
    - colour that stands out from the frame (opponent colour distance from the frame's mean);
    - skin tone, and spectral-residual saliency (Hou & Zhang 2007) as a weak prior.
    The position is the peak of the column profile, refined by a local centroid (an average over the whole
    frame would drift to the centre on textured scenes)."""
    n = len(fr)
    if n == 0:
        return np.zeros(0, np.float32), np.zeros(0, np.float32)
    f = fr[:, ::2, ::2].astype(np.float32) / 255.0

"""Intake: probes every clip, makes a light edit master when needed, and measures everything the line will use."""

from __future__ import annotations

from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np

from ... import media
from .. import analysis as an
from .. import look
from ..model import AgentRun, Clip
from .base import Agent, Ctx, save_jpg


def ingest(ctx: Ctx, clip: Clip, say) -> bool:
    """Measure one clip. Returns False when it was already measured (nothing to do)."""
    npz = ctx.root / "analysis" / f"{clip.id}.npz"
    if clip.analysis and npz.exists() and clip.master and ctx.abs(clip.master).exists():
        return False
    src = ctx.abs(clip.path)
    info = media.probe(src)
    clip.duration, clip.width, clip.height = info["duration"], info["width"], info["height"]
    clip.fps, clip.has_audio = info["fps"] or 30.0, info["has_audio"]
    fps_a = float(min(np.clip(1500 / max(clip.duration, 1), 2, 10), clip.fps))
    size = an.analysis_size(clip.width, clip.height)
    big = max(clip.width, clip.height) > 1920 or info["vcodec"] not in ("h264",)
    if big:
        msize = an.master_size(clip.width, clip.height)
        out = ctx.root / "media" / f"{clip.id}_master.mp4"
        fr = an.master_and_frames(src, out, msize, fps_a, size, clip.fps, clip.has_audio)
        clip.master = ctx.rel(out)
        say(f"{clip.name}: {clip.width}x{clip.height} {info['vcodec']} → {msize[0]}x{msize[1]} edit master "
            f"(1 s keyframes, every cut seeks instantly)")
    else:
        fr = an.frames(src, fps_a, size)
        clip.master = clip.path
    m = an.measure(fr)
    sx, conf = an.subject_track(fr)
    sxs = an.smooth(sx, max(3, int(round(fps_a * 1.2))))
    clip.cuts = an.detect_cuts(m["hdist"], m["motion"], fps_a)
    edges = [0.0, *clip.cuts, clip.duration]
    clip.shots = [[round(a, 3), round(b, 3)] for a, b in zip(edges, edges[1:])]
    px = look.pixel_sample(fr)
    st = look.stats(px)
    clip.levels = st
    clip.flat = (st["luma"][4] - st["luma"][0] < 0.75) or st["sat"] < 0.12
    sharp_n = an.norm(m["sharp"])
    quality = sharp_n - np.abs(m["bright"] - 0.45) * 1.2 - 2 * (m["hi"] + m["lo"])
    lo, hi = int(len(quality) * 0.1), max(int(len(quality) * 0.9), int(len(quality) * 0.1) + 1)
    clip.best_t = round(float((lo + int(np.argmax(quality[lo:hi]))) / fps_a), 2) if len(quality) else 0.0
    w = np.clip(conf, 1, None)
    clip.subject = round(float((sxs * w).sum() / w.sum()), 3) if len(sxs) else 0.5
    db = np.zeros(1, np.float32)
    if clip.has_audio:
        db = an.envelope_db(an.pcm(ctx.abs(clip.master), 16000), 16000)
        if float(db.max()) < -55:
            clip.has_audio = False
            say(f"{clip.name}: the audio track is silent; treating the clip as silent")
        else:
            clip.sound = an.sound_regions(db)
    npz.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    step = max(1, len(px) // 40000)
    np.savez_compressed(npz, t=np.arange(len(fr), dtype=np.float32) / fps_a, sharp=m["sharp"], motion=m["motion"],
                        bright=m["bright"], sat=m["sat"], hi=m["hi"], lo=m["lo"], hdist=m["hdist"], rgb=m["rgb"],
                        sx=sxs, sx_raw=sx, conf=conf, px=(px[::step] * 255).astype(np.uint8), th=an.thumbs(fr), db=db)
    clip.analysis, clip.analysis_fps = ctx.rel(npz), round(fps_a, 4)
    stills = ctx.root / "stills"
    media.frame(ctx.abs(clip.master), clip.best_t, stills / f"{clip.id}_poster.jpg", height=360)
    clip.poster = f"stills/{clip.id}_poster.jpg"
    idx = np.linspace(0, len(fr) - 1, 8).astype(int) if len(fr) else []
    if len(idx):
        save_jpg(np.concatenate([fr[i] for i in idx], axis=1), stills / f"{clip.id}_strip.jpg")
        clip.filmstrip = f"stills/{clip.id}_strip.jpg"
    return True


class Intake(Agent):
    key, title, icon, color = "intake", "Intake", "layers", "#7aa2f7"
    role = "probes every clip, builds a light edit master and measures sharpness, motion, exposure, cuts, subject and sound"

    def inputs(self, ctx: Ctx):
        return [(c.id, c.path, c.analysis) for c in ctx.project.clips]

    def run(self, ctx: Ctx, rep: AgentRun) -> None:
        clips = ctx.project.clips
        if not clips:
            raise RuntimeError("no footage: add at least one clip")

        def one(c: Clip) -> bool:
            return ingest(ctx, c, lambda m: self.say(ctx, m))

        with ThreadPoolExecutor(2) as ex:
            fresh = list(ex.map(one, clips))
        for c, new in zip(clips, fresh):
            lv = c.levels
            bits = [f"{c.width}x{c.height} {c.fps:g} fps {c.duration:.1f}s",
                    f"{len(c.cuts)} camera cut{'s' if len(c.cuts) != 1 else ''}",
                    "flat/log colour" if c.flat else "normal contrast",
                    f"subject around x={c.subject:.2f}",
                    f"{len(c.sound)} sound stretches" if c.has_audio else "no sound"]
            self.decide(ctx, rep, f"{c.id} {c.name}: " + " · ".join(bits) + ("" if new else " (measured earlier)"))
            self.check(ctx, rep, f"{c.id} measured", bool(c.analysis) and lv.get("luma") is not None,
                       f"luma {lv['luma'][0]:.2f}–{lv['luma'][4]:.2f}, saturation {lv['sat']:.2f}")
        total = sum(c.duration for c in clips)
        rep.summary = f"{len(clips)} clip{'s' if len(clips) > 1 else ''}, {total:.1f}s of footage measured"
        rep.preview = clips[0].poster

"""Export: renders every segment in parallel (unchanged segments are reused), assembles cuts and transitions,
burns in the type, lays the soundtrack under it, and writes the deliverables: the video, a poster, the edit
decision list (CMX 3600, opens in Premiere / Resolve) and the edit as JSON."""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
from pathlib import Path

from ... import media
from ..model import AgentRun
from ..render import render_segment
from .base import Agent, Ctx, fps_arg, frame_size, out_fps

XFADE = {"whip": "slideleft", "dissolve": "fade", "flash": "fadewhite"}


def _tc(t: float, fps: float) -> str:
    f = int(round(fps))
    n = int(round(t * fps))
    return f"{n // (3600 * f):02d}:{n // (60 * f) % 60:02d}:{n // f % 60:02d}:{n % f:02d}"


def edl(ctx: Ctx, fps: float) -> str:
    p = ctx.project
    lines = [f"TITLE: {p.name}", "FCM: NON-DROP FRAME", ""]
    n = 0
    for g in p.timeline:
        if g.kind != "clip":
            continue
        n += 1
        c = p.clip(g.clip)
        reel = c.id.upper()[:8]
        lines.append(f"{n:03d}  {reel:<8} V     C        {_tc(g.src_in, fps)} {_tc(g.src_out, fps)} "
                     f"{_tc(g.start, fps)} {_tc(g.start + g.length, fps)}")
        lines.append(f"* FROM CLIP NAME: {c.name}")
        if abs(g.speed - 1) > 1e-3:
            lines.append(f"M2   {reel:<8}      {g.speed * fps:05.1f}                {_tc(g.src_in, fps)}")
        if g.trans != "cut":
            lines.append(f"* TRANSITION: {g.trans} {g.trans_d:.2f}s")
        lines.append(f"* {g.role.upper()}: {g.why}")
        lines.append("")
    return "\n".join(lines)


class Export(Agent):
    key, title, icon, color = "export", "Export", "export", "#7dcfff"
    role = "renders every segment in parallel, assembles cuts and transitions, burns in the type, lays in the sound"
    needs = ("colorist", "typographer", "mixer")

    def inputs(self, ctx: Ctx):
        p = ctx.project
        return [p.timeline and [g.model_dump(exclude={"thumb", "why", "score"}) for g in p.timeline], p.look.get("luts"),
                p.look.get("fx"), p.look.get("grain"), ctx.skill.get("motion"), ctx.settings.aspect, ctx.settings.resolution,
                out_fps(p), (ctx.root / "render" / "text.ass").read_text(encoding="utf-8") if (ctx.root / "render" / "text.ass").exists() else "",
                p.audio.file, p.audio.model_dump()]

    def run(self, ctx: Ctx, rep: AgentRun) -> None:
        p, s = ctx.project, ctx.settings
        W, H = frame_size(s)
        fps = out_fps(p)
        fx, grain = dict(p.look.get("fx") or {}), p.look.get("grain")
        letterbox = fx.pop("letterbox", None)
        M = dict(ctx.skill.get("motion") or {})
        segdir = ctx.root / "render" / "segs"
        segdir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        tl = p.timeline
        jobs = []
        for i, g in enumerate(tl):
            lut = p.look.get("luts", {}).get(g.clip) if g.kind == "clip" else None
            whip_in = g.trans_d / 2 + 0.03 if g.trans == "whip" else 0.0
            nxt = tl[i + 1] if i + 1 < len(tl) else None
            whip_out = nxt.trans_d / 2 + 0.03 if nxt is not None and nxt.trans == "whip" else 0.0
            key = hashlib.sha1(json.dumps([g.model_dump(exclude={"thumb", "why", "score", "start", "id", "role"}),
                                           p.clip(g.clip).master if g.kind == "clip" else "", lut, fx, grain, W, H, fps,
                                           {k: M.get(k) for k in ("cadence", "weave")}, whip_in, whip_out, "v1"],
                                          sort_keys=True, default=str).encode()).hexdigest()[:14]
            jobs.append((g, lut, whip_in, whip_out, segdir / f"{key}.mp4"))
        todo = [j for j in jobs if not j[4].exists()]
        self.say(ctx, f"rendering {len(todo)} of {len(jobs)} segments ({len(jobs) - len(todo)} unchanged, reused)")

        def one(job):
            g, lut, wi, wo, out = job
            tmp = out.with_suffix(".tmp.mp4")
            render_segment(ctx, g, p.clip(g.clip) if g.kind == "clip" else None, W, H, fps, lut, fx, grain,
                           M, tmp, wi, wo)
            tmp.replace(out)
            return g.id

        with ThreadPoolExecutor(3) as ex:
            for sid in ex.map(one, todo):
                self.say(ctx, f"segment {sid} rendered", kind="progress", seg=sid)
        # assemble
        inputs, graph = [], []
        for i, (g, *_rest, out) in enumerate(jobs):
            inputs += ["-i", ctx.rel(out)]
            graph.append(f"[{i}:v]settb=AVTB,setpts=PTS-STARTPTS,fps={fps_arg(fps)},format=yuv420p[s{i}]")
        acc, acc_d = "s0", tl[0].length
        for i in range(1, len(tl)):
            g = tl[i]
            if g.trans != "cut" and g.trans_d > 0:
                graph.append(f"[{acc}][s{i}]xfade=transition={XFADE.get(g.trans, 'fade')}:duration={g.trans_d:.4f}:"
                             f"offset={max(acc_d - g.trans_d, 0):.4f}[x{i}]")
                acc_d += g.length - g.trans_d
            else:
                graph.append(f"[{acc}][s{i}]concat=n=2:v=1:a=0[x{i}]")
                acc_d += g.length
            acc = f"x{i}"
        post = []
        if letterbox and W > H:
            bar = max(0, int(round((H - W / float(letterbox)) / 2)))
            if bar:
                post.append(f"drawbox=x=0:y=0:w=iw:h={bar}:color=black:t=fill,drawbox=x=0:y=ih-{bar}:w=iw:h={bar}:color=black:t=fill")
        if p.texts and (ctx.root / "render" / "text.ass").exists():
            post.append("subtitles=render/text.ass:fontsdir=render/fonts")
        post.append("format=yuv420p")
        graph.append(f"[{acc}]{','.join(post)}[vout]")
        audio_i = len(jobs)
        inputs += ["-i", p.audio.file]
        final = ctx.root / "final.mp4"
        tmp = ctx.root / "final.tmp.mp4"
        T = p.duration
        ctx.ffmpeg(["-y", *inputs, "-filter_complex", ";".join(graph), "-map", "[vout]", "-map", f"{audio_i}:a",
                    "-c:v", "libx264", "-preset", "medium", "-crf", "18", "-profile:v", "high", "-pix_fmt", "yuv420p",
                    "-color_primaries", "bt709", "-color_trc", "bt709", "-colorspace", "bt709", "-r", fps_arg(fps),
                    "-c:a", "aac", "-b:a", "256k", "-ar", "48000", "-t", f"{T:.4f}", "-movflags", "+faststart",
                    ctx.rel(tmp)], timeout=3600)
        tmp.replace(final)
        # thumbnails for the timeline + poster
        thumbs = ctx.root / "render" / "thumbs"
        thumbs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        for f in thumbs.glob("t_*.jpg"):
            f.unlink()
        frames = [max(0, int(round((g.start + g.length / 2) * fps))) for g in tl]
        sel = "+".join(f"eq(n,{n})" for n in sorted(set(frames)))
        ctx.ffmpeg(["-y", "-i", "final.mp4", "-vf", f"select='{sel}',scale=-2:160", "-fps_mode", "passthrough",
                    "-q:v", "4", "render/thumbs/t_%03d.jpg"])
        order = sorted(set(frames))
        for g, n in zip(tl, frames):
            g.thumb = f"render/thumbs/t_{order.index(n) + 1:03d}.jpg"
        story = next((t for t in p.texts if t.kind in ("story", "stamp")), None)
        pt = (story.start + story.end) / 2 if story else next((g.start + g.length / 2 for g in tl if g.kind == "clip"), 0)
        media.frame(final, pt, ctx.root / "poster.jpg", height=720)
        (ctx.root / "edit.edl").write_text(edl(ctx, fps), encoding="utf-8")
        (ctx.root / "edit.json").write_text(json.dumps({"timeline": [g.model_dump() for g in tl],
                                                        "texts": [t.model_dump() for t in p.texts],
                                                        "audio": p.audio.model_dump(), "look": {k: v for k, v in p.look.items() if k != "graded"},
                                                        "credit": p.track.credit if p.track else None}, indent=1), encoding="utf-8")
        size = final.stat().st_size
        p.outputs = {"video": "final.mp4", "poster": "poster.jpg", "edl": "edit.edl", "json": "edit.json",
                     "bytes": size, "width": W, "height": H, "fps": fps, "duration": T,
                     "credit": p.track.credit if p.track else ""}
        self.decide(ctx, rep, f"final.mp4: {W}x{H} {fps:g} fps, {T:.1f}s, {size / 1e6:.1f} MB (H.264 + AAC, Rec.709)")
        self.decide(ctx, rep, f"{len(todo)} segment(s) rendered, {len(jobs) - len(todo)} reused · edit list for Premiere/Resolve: edit.edl")
        rep.preview = "poster.jpg"
        rep.summary = f"{W}x{H} · {T:.1f}s · {len(todo)}/{len(jobs)} rendered"

"""Export: renders every segment in parallel (unchanged segments are reused), assembles cuts and transitions,
burns in the type, lays the soundtrack under it, and writes the deliverables: the video, a poster, the edit
decision list (CMX 3600, opens in Premiere / Resolve) and the edit as JSON."""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
from pathlib import Path

from ... import media
from ..model import AgentRun
from ..render import render_segment
from .base import Agent, Ctx, fps_arg, frame_size, out_fps

XFADE = {"whip": "slideleft", "dissolve": "fade", "flash": "fadewhite"}


def _tc(t: float, fps: float) -> str:
    f = int(round(fps))
    n = int(round(t * fps))
    return f"{n // (3600 * f):02d}:{n // (60 * f) % 60:02d}:{n // f % 60:02d}:{n % f:02d}"


def edl(ctx: Ctx, fps: float) -> str:
    p = ctx.project
    lines = [f"TITLE: {p.name}", "FCM: NON-DROP FRAME", ""]
    n = 0
    for g in p.timeline:
        if g.kind != "clip":
            continue
        n += 1
        c = p.clip(g.clip)
        reel = c.id.upper()[:8]
        lines.append(f"{n:03d}  {reel:<8} V     C        {_tc(g.src_in, fps)} {_tc(g.src_out, fps)} "
                     f"{_tc(g.start, fps)} {_tc(g.start + g.length, fps)}")
        lines.append(f"* FROM CLIP NAME: {c.name}")
        if abs(g.speed - 1) > 1e-3:
            lines.append(f"M2   {reel:<8}      {g.speed * fps:05.1f}                {_tc(g.src_in, fps)}")
        if g.trans != "cut":
            lines.append(f"* TRANSITION: {g.trans} {g.trans_d:.2f}s")
        lines.append(f"* {g.role.upper()}: {g.why}")
        lines.append("")
    return "\n".join(lines)


class Export(Agent):
    key, title, icon, color = "export", "Export", "export", "#7dcfff"
    role = "renders every segment in parallel, assembles cuts and transitions, burns in the type, lays in the sound"
    needs = ("colorist", "typographer", "mixer")

    def inputs(self, ctx: Ctx):
        p = ctx.project
        return [p.timeline and [g.model_dump(exclude={"thumb", "why", "score"}) for g in p.timeline], p.look.get("luts"),
                p.look.get("fx"), p.look.get("grain"), ctx.skill.get("motion"), ctx.settings.aspect, ctx.settings.resolution,
                out_fps(p), (ctx.root / "render" / "text.ass").read_text(encoding="utf-8") if (ctx.root / "render" / "text.ass").exists() else "",
                p.audio.file, p.audio.model_dump()]

    def run(self, ctx: Ctx, rep: AgentRun) -> None:
        p, s = ctx.project, ctx.settings
        W, H = frame_size(s)
        fps = out_fps(p)
        fx, grain = dict(p.look.get("fx") or {}), p.look.get("grain")
        letterbox = fx.pop("letterbox", None)
        M = dict(ctx.skill.get("motion") or {})
        segdir = ctx.root / "render" / "segs"
        segdir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        tl = p.timeline
        jobs = []
        for i, g in enumerate(tl):
            lut = p.look.get("luts", {}).get(g.clip) if g.kind == "clip" else None
            whip_in = g.trans_d / 2 + 0.03 if g.trans == "whip" else 0.0
            nxt = tl[i + 1] if i + 1 < len(tl) else None
            whip_out = nxt.trans_d / 2 + 0.03 if nxt is not None and nxt.trans == "whip" else 0.0
            key = hashlib.sha1(json.dumps([g.model_dump(exclude={"thumb", "why", "score", "start", "id", "role"}),
                                           p.clip(g.clip).master if g.kind == "clip" else "", lut, fx, grain, W, H, fps,
                                           {k: M.get(k) for k in ("cadence", "weave")}, whip_in, whip_out, "v1"],
                                          sort_keys=True, default=str).encode()).hexdigest()[:14]
            jobs.append((g, lut, whip_in, whip_out, segdir / f"{key}.mp4"))
        todo = [j for j in jobs if not j[4].exists()]
        self.say(ctx, f"rendering {len(todo)} of {len(jobs)} segments ({len(jobs) - len(todo)} unchanged, reused)")

        def one(job):
            g, lut, wi, wo, out = job
            tmp = out.with_suffix(".tmp.mp4")
            render_segment(ctx, g, p.clip(g.clip) if g.kind == "clip" else None, W, H, fps, lut, fx, grain,
                           M, tmp, wi, wo)
            tmp.replace(out)
            return g.id

        with ThreadPoolExecutor(3) as ex:
            for sid in ex.map(one, todo):
                self.say(ctx, f"segment {sid} rendered", kind="progress", seg=sid)
        # assemble
        inputs, graph = [], []
        for i, (g, *_rest, out) in enumerate(jobs):
            inputs += ["-i", ctx.rel(out)]
            graph.append(f"[{i}:v]settb=AVTB,setpts=PTS-STARTPTS,fps={fps_arg(fps)},format=yuv420p[s{i}]")
        acc, acc_d = "s0", tl[0].length
        for i in range(1, len(tl)):
            g = tl[i]
            if g.trans != "cut" and g.trans_d > 0:
                graph.append(f"[{acc}][s{i}]xfade=transition={XFADE.get(g.trans, 'fade')}:duration={g.trans_d:.4f}:"
                             f"offset={max(acc_d - g.trans_d, 0):.4f}[x{i}]")
                acc_d += g.length - g.trans_d
            else:
                graph.append(f"[{acc}][s{i}]concat=n=2:v=1:a=0[x{i}]")
                acc_d += g.length
            acc = f"x{i}"
        post = []
        if letterbox and W > H:
            bar = max(0, int(round((H - W / float(letterbox)) / 2)))
            if bar:
                post.append(f"drawbox=x=0:y=0:w=iw:h={bar}:color=black:t=fill,drawbox=x=0:y=ih-{bar}:w=iw:h={bar}:color=black:t=fill")
        if p.texts and (ctx.root / "render" / "text.ass").exists():
            post.append("subtitles=render/text.ass:fontsdir=render/fonts")
        post.append("format=yuv420p")
        graph.append(f"[{acc}]{','.join(post)}[vout]")
        audio_i = len(jobs)
        inputs += ["-i", p.audio.file]
        final = ctx.root / "final.mp4"
        tmp = ctx.root / "final.tmp.mp4"
        T = p.duration
        args = ["-y", *inputs, "-filter_complex", ";".join(graph), "-map", "[vout]", "-map", f"{audio_i}:a",
                "-c:v", "libx264", "-preset", "medium", "-crf", "18", "-profile:v", "high", "-pix_fmt", "yuv420p",
                "-color_primaries", "bt709", "-color_trc", "bt709", "-colorspace", "bt709", "-r", fps_arg(fps),
                "-c:a", "aac", "-b:a", "256k", "-ar", "48000", "-t", f"{T:.4f}", "-movflags", "+faststart", ctx.rel(tmp)]
        (ctx.root / "render" / "assemble.json").write_text(json.dumps(args, indent=0), encoding="utf-8")
        ctx.ffmpeg(args, timeout=3600)
        tmp.replace(final)
        # thumbnails for the timeline + poster
        thumbs = ctx.root / "render" / "thumbs"
        thumbs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        for f in thumbs.glob("t_*.jpg"):
            f.unlink()
        frames = [max(0, int(round((g.start + g.length / 2) * fps))) for g in tl]
        sel = "+".join(f"eq(n,{n})" for n in sorted(set(frames)))
        ctx.ffmpeg(["-y", "-i", "final.mp4", "-vf", f"select='{sel}',scale=-2:160", "-fps_mode", "passthrough",
                    "-q:v", "4", "render/thumbs/t_%03d.jpg"])
        order = sorted(set(frames))
        for g, n in zip(tl, frames):
            g.thumb = f"render/thumbs/t_{order.index(n) + 1:03d}.jpg"
        story = next((t for t in p.texts if t.kind in ("story", "stamp")), None)
        pt = (story.start + story.end) / 2 if story else next((g.start + g.length / 2 for g in tl if g.kind == "clip"), 0)
        media.frame(final, pt, ctx.root / "poster.jpg", height=720)
        (ctx.root / "edit.edl").write_text(edl(ctx, fps), encoding="utf-8")
        (ctx.root / "edit.json").write_text(json.dumps({"timeline": [g.model_dump() for g in tl],
                                                        "texts": [t.model_dump() for t in p.texts],
                                                        "audio": p.audio.model_dump(), "look": {k: v for k, v in p.look.items() if k != "graded"},
                                                        "credit": p.track.credit if p.track else None}, indent=1), encoding="utf-8")
        size = final.stat().st_size
        p.outputs = {"video": "final.mp4", "poster": "poster.jpg", "edl": "edit.edl", "json": "edit.json",
                     "bytes": size, "width": W, "height": H, "fps": fps, "duration": T,
                     "credit": p.track.credit if p.track else ""}
        self.decide(ctx, rep, f"final.mp4: {W}x{H} {fps:g} fps, {T:.1f}s, {size / 1e6:.1f} MB (H.264 + AAC, Rec.709)")
        self.decide(ctx, rep, f"{len(todo)} segment(s) rendered, {len(jobs) - len(todo)} reused · edit list for Premiere/Resolve: edit.edl")
        rep.preview = "poster.jpg"
        rep.summary = f"{W}x{H} · {T:.1f}s · {len(todo)}/{len(jobs)} rendered"

"""Filtergraphs shared by the Export agent (whole segments) and the agents' preview stills (single frames).

One segment = trim → speed → frame-rate → reframe (cover-scale + crop that can pan; perspective for smooth
zoom, punch-ins and gate weave) → colour (the clip's 3D LUT) → RGB effects (halation, glow, vignette...)
→ YUV effects (grain on luma, flicker) → fades and whip blur.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import math
from pathlib import Path

from .agents.base import Ctx, fps_arg
from .look import fx_rgb, fx_yuv
from .model import Clip, Seg


def _even_up(x: float) -> int:
    return int(math.ceil(x / 2) * 2)


def cover(sw: int, sh: int, W: int, H: int, z: float = 1.0) -> tuple[int, int]:
    s = max(W / sw, H / sh) * z
    return _even_up(sw * s), _even_up(sh * s)


def window(clip: Clip, W: int, H: int) -> float:
    """Fraction of the source width that is visible after a cover-crop to W x H (at zoom 1)."""
    return min(1.0, (W / H) / (clip.width / clip.height))


def video_graph(seg: Seg, clip: Clip, W: int, H: int, fps: float, lut: str | None, fx: dict,
                grain: float | None, motion: dict, whip_in: float = 0.0, whip_out: float = 0.0,
                still: bool = False) -> str:
    """Filtergraph from [0:v] to [v] for one clip segment."""
    L = max(seg.length, 1 / fps)
    chain = ["setpts=PTS-STARTPTS"]
    if abs(seg.speed - 1) > 1e-3:
        chain.append(f"setpts=PTS/{seg.speed:.5f}")
    if motion.get("cadence") and not still:
        chain.append(f"fps={int(motion['cadence'])}")
    if not still:
        chain.append(f"fps={fps_arg(fps)}")
    graded = f"format=gbrp,lut3d=file={lut}:interp=tetrahedral" if lut else "format=gbrp"
    parts: list[str] = []
    if seg.fill in ("blur", "fit"):
        parts.append(f"[0:v]{','.join(chain)},{graded},split[bgs][fgs]")
        if seg.fill == "blur":
            parts.append(f"[bgs]scale={W}:{H}:force_original_aspect_ratio=increase,crop={W}:{H},"
                         f"gblur=sigma={min(W, H) * 0.045:.1f},colorlevels=romax=0.8:gomax=0.8:bomax=0.8[bg]")
        else:
            parts.append(f"[bgs]scale={W}:{H},colorlevels=romax=0:gomax=0:bomax=0[bg]")
        parts.append(f"[fgs]scale={W}:{H}:force_original_aspect_ratio=decrease:flags=lanczos[fg]")
        parts.append("[bg][fg]overlay=(W-w)/2:(H-h)/2[in]")
    else:
        z0, z1 = max(seg.zoom0, 1.0), max(seg.zoom1, 1.0)
        zs = min(z0, z1)
        cw, ch = cover(clip.width, clip.height, W, H, zs)
        xa = min(max(seg.x0 * cw - W / 2, 0), cw - W)
        xb = min(max(seg.x1 * cw - W / 2, 0), cw - W)
        y = (ch - H) // 2
        if abs(xb - xa) < 1:
            crop = f"crop={W}:{H}:x={int(xa)}:y={y}"
        else:
            crop = f"crop={W}:{H}:x='{xa:.1f}+({xb - xa:.1f})*min(t/{L:.3f},1)':y={y}"
        steps = [*chain, f"scale={cw}:{ch}:flags=lanczos", crop]
        r0, r1 = z0 / zs, z1 / zs
        weave = float(motion.get("weave") or 0)
        if abs(r0 - 1) > 1e-3 or abs(r1 - 1) > 1e-3 or weave:
            tt = f"(in/{fps:.4f})"
            if seg.zoom_ease == "punch":
                r = f"({r1:.4f}+({r0 - r1:.4f})*pow(max(0,1-{tt}/0.28),2))"
            else:
                r = f"({r0:.4f}+({r1 - r0:.4f})*min({tt}/{L:.3f},1))"
            dx = dy = "0"
            if weave:
                a = weave * W / 1080
                r = f"(1.04*{r})"
                dx = f"({a:.2f}*(sin({tt}*5.3)+0.6*sin({tt}*11.1+1.3)))"
                dy = f"({a * 0.7:.2f}*(sin({tt}*4.1+0.7)+0.5*sin({tt}*9.7)))"
            hw, hh = f"(W/(2*{r}))", f"(H/(2*{r}))"
            cx, cy = f"(W/2+{dx})", f"(H/2+{dy})"
            steps.append(f"perspective=x0='{cx}-{hw}':y0='{cy}-{hh}':x1='{cx}+{hw}':y1='{cy}-{hh}':"
                         f"x2='{cx}-{hw}':y2='{cy}+{hh}':x3='{cx}+{hw}':y3='{cy}+{hh}':interpolation=linear:eval=frame")
        steps.append(graded)
        parts.append(f"[0:v]{','.join(steps)}[in]")
    rgb = fx_rgb(fx, W, H)
    parts.append(rgb)
    tail = ["scale=out_color_matrix=bt709:out_range=tv", "format=yuv420p", *fx_yuv(fx, grain, min(W, H))]
    if not still:
        if seg.fade_in > 0:
            tail.append(f"fade=t=in:st=0:d={seg.fade_in:.3f}")
        if seg.fade_out > 0:
            tail.append(f"fade=t=out:st={max(L - seg.fade_out, 0):.3f}:d={seg.fade_out:.3f}")
        radius = max(8, round(W * 0.05))
        if whip_in:
            tail.append(f"dblur=angle=0:radius={radius}:enable='lt(t,{whip_in:.3f})'")
        if whip_out:
            tail.append(f"dblur=angle=0:radius={radius}:enable='gt(t,{L - whip_out:.3f})'")
    parts.append(f"[out]{','.join(tail)}[v]")
    return ";".join(parts)


def card_graph(seg: Seg, W: int, H: int, fps: float) -> list[str]:
    return ["-f", "lavfi", "-i", f"color=c=black:s={W}x{H}:r={fps_arg(fps)}:d={seg.length:.4f}"]


def render_segment(ctx: Ctx, seg: Seg, clip: Clip | None, W: int, H: int, fps: float, lut: str | None,
                   fx: dict, grain: float | None, motion: dict, out: Path, whip_in: float = 0.0,
                   whip_out: float = 0.0) -> Path:
    enc = ["-c:v", "libx264", "-preset", "veryfast", "-crf", "14", "-pix_fmt", "yuv420p", "-color_primaries", "bt709",
           "-color_trc", "bt709", "-colorspace", "bt709", "-an", "-r", fps_arg(fps), "-t", f"{seg.length:.4f}"]
    if seg.kind == "card" or clip is None:
        ctx.ffmpeg(["-y", *card_graph(seg, W, H, fps), "-vf", "format=yuv420p", *enc, ctx.rel(out)])
        return out
    span = seg.src_out - seg.src_in

          grain: float | None = None, x: float | None = None, zoom: float = 1.0, ass: str | None = None,
          ass_t: float = 0.0, fill: str = "crop") -> Path:
    """One graded frame, framed exactly like the render (for the agents' previews and the look gallery)."""
    seg = Seg(id=0, clip=clip.id, src_in=t, src_out=t + 0.04, x0=x if x is not None else clip.subject,
              x1=x if x is not None else clip.subject, zoom0=zoom, zoom1=zoom, fill=fill)
    graph = video_graph(seg, clip, W, H, 25.0, lut, fx or {}, grain, {}, still=True)
    if ass:
        graph = graph[: graph.rfind("[v]")] + f",setpts=PTS-STARTPTS+{ass_t:.3f}/TB,subtitles={ass}:fontsdir=render/fonts[v]"
    out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    ctx.ffmpeg(["-y", "-ss", f"{max(t, 0):.3f}", "-i", clip.master, "-filter_complex", graph, "-map", "[v]",
                "-frames:v", "1", "-q:v", "3", ctx.rel(out)])
    return out

"""Export: renders every segment in parallel (unchanged segments are reused), assembles cuts and transitions,
burns in the type, lays the soundtrack under it, and writes the deliverables: the video, a poster, the edit
decision list (CMX 3600, opens in Premiere / Resolve) and the edit as JSON."""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
from pathlib import Path

from ... import media
from ..model import AgentRun
from ..render import render_segment
from .base import Agent, Ctx, fps_arg, frame_size, out_fps

XFADE = {"whip": "slideleft", "dissolve": "fade", "flash": "fadewhite"}


def _tc(t: float, fps: float) -> str:
    f = int(round(fps))
    n = int(round(t * fps))
    return f"{n // (3600 * f):02d}:{n // (60 * f) % 60:02d}:{n // f % 60:02d}:{n % f:02d}"


def edl(ctx: Ctx, fps: float) -> str:
    p = ctx.project
    lines = [f"TITLE: {p.name}", "FCM: NON-DROP FRAME", ""]
    n = 0
    for g in p.timeline:
        if g.kind != "clip":
            continue
        n += 1
        c = p.clip(g.clip)
        reel = c.id.upper()[:8]
        lines.append(f"{n:03d}  {reel:<8} V     C        {_tc(g.src_in, fps)} {_tc(g.src_out, fps)} "
                     f"{_tc(g.start, fps)} {_tc(g.start + g.length, fps)}")
        lines.append(f"* FROM CLIP NAME: {c.name}")
        if abs(g.speed - 1) > 1e-3:
            lines.append(f"M2   {reel:<8}      {g.speed * fps:05.1f}                {_tc(g.src_in, fps)}")
        if g.trans != "cut":
            lines.append(f"* TRANSITION: {g.trans} {g.trans_d:.2f}s")
        lines.append(f"* {g.role.upper()}: {g.why}")
        lines.append("")
    return "\n".join(lines)


class Export(Agent):
    key, title, icon, color = "export", "Export", "export", "#7dcfff"
    role = "renders every segment in parallel, assembles cuts and transitions, burns in the type, lays in the sound"
    needs = ("colorist", "typographer", "mixer")

    def inputs(self, ctx: Ctx):
        p = ctx.project
        return [p.timeline and [g.model_dump(exclude={"thumb", "why", "score"}) for g in p.timeline], p.look.get("luts"),
                p.look.get("fx"), p.look.get("grain"), ctx.skill.get("motion"), ctx.settings.aspect, ctx.settings.resolution,
                out_fps(p), (ctx.root / "render" / "text.ass").read_text(encoding="utf-8") if (ctx.root / "render" / "text.ass").exists() else "",
                p.audio.file, p.audio.model_dump()]

    def run(self, ctx: Ctx, rep: AgentRun) -> None:
        p, s = ctx.project, ctx.settings
        W, H = frame_size(s)
        fps = out_fps(p)
        fx, grain = dict(p.look.get("fx") or {}), p.look.get("grain")
        letterbox = fx.pop("letterbox", None)
        M = dict(ctx.skill.get("motion") or {})
        segdir = ctx.root / "render" / "segs"
        segdir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        tl = p.timeline
        jobs = []
        for i, g in enumerate(tl):
            lut = p.look.get("luts", {}).get(g.clip) if g.kind == "clip" else None
            whip_in = g.trans_d / 2 + 0.03 if g.trans == "whip" else 0.0
            nxt = tl[i + 1] if i + 1 < len(tl) else None
            whip_out = nxt.trans_d / 2 + 0.03 if nxt is not None and nxt.trans == "whip" else 0.0
            key = hashlib.sha1(json.dumps([g.model_dump(exclude={"thumb", "why", "score", "start", "id", "role"}),
                                           p.clip(g.clip).master if g.kind == "clip" else "", lut, fx, grain, W, H, fps,
                                           {k: M.get(k) for k in ("cadence", "weave")}, whip_in, whip_out, "v1"],
                                          sort_keys=True, default=str).encode()).hexdigest()[:14]
            jobs.append((g, lut, whip_in, whip_out, segdir / f"{key}.mp4"))
        todo = [j for j in jobs if not j[4].exists()]
        self.say(ctx, f"rendering {len(todo)} of {len(jobs)} segments ({len(jobs) - len(todo)} unchanged, reused)")

        def one(job):
            g, lut, wi, wo, out = job
            tmp = out.with_suffix(".tmp.mp4")
            render_segment(ctx, g, p.clip(g.clip) if g.kind == "clip" else None, W, H, fps, lut, fx, grain,
                           M, tmp, wi, wo)
            tmp.replace(out)
            return g.id

        with ThreadPoolExecutor(3) as ex:
            for sid in ex.map(one, todo):
                self.say(ctx, f"segment {sid} rendered", kind="progress", seg=sid)
        # assemble
        inputs, graph = [], []
        for i, (g, *_rest, out) in enumerate(jobs):
            inputs += ["-i", ctx.rel(out)]
            graph.append(f"[{i}:v]settb=AVTB,setpts=PTS-STARTPTS,fps={fps_arg(fps)},setsar=1,format=yuv420p[s{i}]")
        acc, acc_d = "s0", tl[0].length
        for i in range(1, len(tl)):
            g = tl[i]
            if g.trans != "cut" and g.trans_d > 0:
                graph.append(f"[{acc}][s{i}]xfade=transition={XFADE.get(g.trans, 'fade')}:duration={g.trans_d:.4f}:"
                             f"offset={max(acc_d - g.trans_d, 0):.4f}[x{i}]")
                acc_d += g.length - g.trans_d
            else:
                graph.append(f"[{acc}][s{i}]concat=n=2:v=1:a=0[x{i}]")
                acc_d += g.length
            acc = f"x{i}"
        post = []
        if letterbox and W > H:
            bar = max(0, int(round((H - W / float(letterbox)) / 2)))
            if bar:
                post.append(f"drawbox=x=0:y=0:w=iw:h={bar}:color=black:t=fill,drawbox=x=0:y=ih-{bar}:w=iw:h={bar}:color=black:t=fill")
        if p.texts and (ctx.root / "render" / "text.ass").exists():
            post.append("subtitles=render/text.ass:fontsdir=render/fonts")
        post.append("format=yuv420p")
        graph.append(f"[{acc}]{','.join(post)}[vout]")
        audio_i = len(jobs)
        inputs += ["-i", p.audio.file]
        final = ctx.root / "final.mp4"
        tmp = ctx.root / "final.tmp.mp4"
        T = p.duration
        args = ["-y", *inputs, "-filter_complex", ";".join(graph), "-map", "[vout]", "-map", f"{audio_i}:a",
                "-c:v", "libx264", "-preset", "medium", "-crf", "18", "-profile:v", "high", "-pix_fmt", "yuv420p",
                "-color_primaries", "bt709", "-color_trc", "bt709", "-colorspace", "bt709", "-r", fps_arg(fps),
                "-c:a", "aac", "-b:a", "256k", "-ar", "48000", "-t", f"{T:.4f}", "-movflags", "+faststart", ctx.rel(tmp)]
        (ctx.root / "render" / "assemble.json").write_text(json.dumps(args, indent=0), encoding="utf-8")
        ctx.ffmpeg(args, timeout=3600)
        tmp.replace(final)
        # thumbnails for the timeline + poster
        thumbs = ctx.root / "render" / "thumbs"
        thumbs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        for f in thumbs.glob("t_*.jpg"):
            f.unlink()
        frames = [max(0, int(round((g.start + g.length / 2) * fps))) for g in tl]
        sel = "+".join(f"eq(n,{n})" for n in sorted(set(frames)))
        ctx.ffmpeg(["-y", "-i", "final.mp4", "-vf", f"select='{sel}',scale=-2:160", "-fps_mode", "passthrough",
                    "-q:v", "4", "render/thumbs/t_%03d.jpg"])
        order = sorted(set(frames))
        for g, n in zip(tl, frames):
            g.thumb = f"render/thumbs/t_{order.index(n) + 1:03d}.jpg"
        story = next((t for t in p.texts if t.kind in ("story", "stamp")), None)
        pt = (story.start + story.end) / 2 if story else next((g.start + g.length / 2 for g in tl if g.kind == "clip"), 0)
        media.frame(final, pt, ctx.root / "poster.jpg", height=720)
        (ctx.root / "edit.edl").write_text(edl(ctx, fps), encoding="utf-8")
        (ctx.root / "edit.json").write_text(json.dumps({"timeline": [g.model_dump() for g in tl],
